## Plan

### Mechanics summary
- 240 HP (250 at A8+) `[GAME]` v0.111.1 (the extract showed 250).
- Moves `[GAME-EXTRACT]`:
  - Pressurize: +15 Steam Eruption
  - Stomp: 15 + Weak on you, +3 Steam
  - Ram: 10 + 3 Steam
  - Siphon: heals, +3 Steam. Heal is 10 at lower ascension (15 at higher) since v0.107.1 `[COMMUNITY]` wiki patch notes
  - **Explosion damage grows with Steam Eruption:** 15 from Pressurize plus 3 for every later move `[GAME-EXTRACT]` (`EXPLODE_MOVE` deals `SteamEruptionDamage`). A long fight means a bigger explosion; the turn before, it shows a stun (`ABOUT_TO_BLOW_MOVE`).
  - Pressure Gun: ? damage + 3 Steam
  - Pressure Up: 13 + 3 Steam
  - About to Blow: stun
  - **Explode: damage equal to its Steam Eruption, then it dies**
- **Steam Eruption** `[GAME-EXTRACT]`: killing the Giant does not end the fight. It stays (invulnerable, stunned `[COMMUNITY]`) and explodes on its next turn.
- **Cycle** `[COMMUNITY]`: turn 1 Pressurize, then Stomp 15 + 1 Weak, Ram 10, Siphon (heal), Pressure Gun 20 (+5 each use), Pressure Up 13, repeating, each move +3 Steam Eruption (selphie1999gaming, 2026-04-05; screenhype, March 2026, gives the first three moves and describes them repeating; both accessed 2026-11-19, no version stated). A wiki-derived data page (slaythespire.wiki.gg data, via search, accessed 2026-11-19) gives the same Pressure Gun numbers (20, +5 per use, +3 Steam), so those have two sources; the full order still has one. The guide's heal is 15; patch notes give 10 at lower ascension since v0.107.1. The same guide says Weak on the Giant lowers the explosion.
- **The wiki confirms the five-move cycle** `[COMMUNITY]` (slaythespire.wiki.gg page, accessed 2026-11-19, beta v0.113.1 page): Pressurize, then Stomp, Ram, Siphon, Pressure Gun, Pressure Up; HP 240 (250 at A8+). About To Blow cleanses its buffs and debuffs; killing it with no Steam Eruption (Doom) skips the explosion.
- **Timing of the explosion** `[COMMUNITY]` + `[GAME-EXTRACT]`: the turn you bring it to 0 HP, its next turn is a stun; on your following turn it shows the explosion; you have that whole turn to block. Steam grows by 3 for each move it makes, so the explosion is 15 + 3 × (moves made since Pressurize): 42 if it dies on your turn 11 (nine moves after Pressurize).

### Deck checklist
- **Countable checks** (`tools/deck_check.py`, tuned on the history 2026-11-19) `[PLAYER-DATA, weak]`: block cards at least 6 (bank block for the death explosion (plan; no data signal)).
- **Kill fast:** each turn adds 3 Steam (the explosion grows by 3 per turn).
- **Keep a big block for the explosion turn** (15 + 3 per turn alive). Impervious or a block potion. Weak on the Giant should reduce the explosion, since it is an attack `[HYPOTHESIS]`.
- Count the stacks every turn (shown as a power on the Giant).

### Simulation `[HYPOTHESIS]` model (`reports/phase2/vantom-simulation.md`)
- With the five-move cycle the model is far too hard (base deck 14% from 60/80 against the Player's 3/5), so it is not used in drafting.
- **Plan:** the safe plan led under both cycles tried: 14% against 1% from 60/80 and 69% against 51% from full HP (five moves); 54% against 11% and 99% against 78% (three moves). Spending HP to kill faster loses to the explosion.
- `tools/advise.py` recommends the safe plan here and prints the Steam Eruption amount.

### HP target on arrival
- Ironclad benchmark: median 38, p75 41. **Rest if HP is below about 48.**

### First three turns
- Damage race from turn 1. When its HP gets low, plan the killing turn so the next turn's block covers the explosion.

### Potion plan
- Save a block potion, or Weak, for the explosion.

### What killed the Player here, and the counter
- Ironclad: 2 of 5 fatal (all characters: 8 of 30). Arrival HP made no difference (59% against 57%), so the end-of-fight explosion and long fights are the likely cause. `[PLAYER-DATA]`
- Counter: fast kill plus banked block for the explosion.
